cases.name: Kaylene "Katy" Harris
cases.narrative:
On New Year's Eve 1999, he slipped into the trailer through
an open window, carrying a 12-inch boning knife. In one bedroom slept Kaylene and her friend, Krystal Surles, 10. According to court documents, Sells got into bed with Kaylene, cut off her underwear and started groping her. Kaylene woke up and ran for the door, but Sells attacked as she tried to open it. He stabbed her 16 times — six of which would have been fatal wounds, the forensic pathologist who performed the autopsy found — and slit her throat multiple times, according to court
documents. Sells then slit Krystal's throat and fled after wiping his fingerprints off a doorknob, court documents state. Krystal played dead until Sells was gone and then left the house, walking through the dark to another home a quarter-mile away.
